question:
Two figures given on the left side of (::) are related with some logic/rule/relation. Select the missing figure on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same logic/rule/relation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f9809dd336dfbb16d4a3fef2595dbce39f13e888f1759d8f94dd83764b3cc71.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The pattern is based on identifying the number of sides of the inner geometric shape and placing that number inside the shape to represent its properties.

In the first pair, the inner shape is a square, which has 4 sides, so the number 4 is placed inside it.

Following the same rule, in the second pair, the inner shape is a pentagon, which has 5 sides, so the number 5 must be placed inside it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d94170f9584941bd7a2499c45b9c3f24cdea8d5f02c0b41e765254ab116bb411.png] 

Comparing all the given options, only option 1 correctly places the number 5 inside the pentagon according to the rule.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
